# Lamplight -- equivalence evidence (step 4 of the migration protocol)

Collected 2026-08-09 with BOTH launchers present and the old one canonical, per AC-11.27. Sealed comparisons cite each run's `verdict:` path; runs strictly sequential (shared `_build` and `tmp/`).

## The examines table

| Gate            | Old (`bin/lamplight`)                                       | New (`bin/devbin`)                                          | Verdict                        |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| test credo      | rc 0; `Checking 2802 source files`; `29667 mods/funs, found no issues.` | rc 0; SAME two lines verbatim; seal `20260809-1940-11.CREDO.errors` 0 bytes | IDENTICAL examined set         |
| test lua        | rc 0; `49 test(s), 49 passed, 0 failed, 0 error(s)` (`--only framework` -- the content half lives behind optional symlinks and is deliberately not a comparison surface) | rc 0; SAME summary line; seal `20260809-1940-43.LUA.errors` | IDENTICAL counts               |
| test rust (cli) | rc 0; 20 green `test result:` targets (11/56/1/7/5/4/11/51/1/1 passed + zero-test targets) | rc 0; the SAME 20 targets with the SAME counts -- only wall-clock times differ; seal `20260809-1942.RUST.errors` 0 bytes | IDENTICAL examined set         |
| test mix        | rc 0; `Result: 43 passed` (SUITE-SCOPED -- the capability fence file; the full suite is the half-hour leg and no comparison needs it) | rc 0; SAME Result line | IDENTICAL counts, sealed       |
| test doctor     | the old fence gates the OLD helpers (exercised above by every old-side sealed run) | the ported fence: 10 checks green against DEVBIN's real purge machinery, legacy-suffix section dropped with its reason | the invariant guarded on the machinery each side actually uses |
| check format    | rc 0; TWO arms (mix format --check-formatted + cargo fmt --check per gated crate) | rc 0; the SAME two arms via `cmd/.lib/check-format`         | same enforcement scope         |
| check clippy    | rc 0 (native/cli, no --all-targets: CI parity)              | rc 0; same invocation via `cmd/.lib/check-clippy`, sealed   | same scope, same verdict       |
| check deps      | rc 1 -- the AUTHORED permanent red (logger deps transitive via arca_cli), named in the output | rc 1 -- SAME red, SAME two deps named, sealed               | A MATCHING RED, carried not fixed; excluded from `all` both sides |
| check toolchain | rc 0 -- three tools green, BLIND to the image               | pre-bump rc 1: same three tools green PLUS `image: elixir 1.20.1 otp 29.0.2` with both skews named (seal `20260809-1936.TOOLCHAIN.errors`); post-bump rc 0 with `image: elixir 1.20.3 otp 29.0.5` | the strengthening pair: the old gate could not go red on the fact that was false; the new arm did, and the sweep turned it green |
| check compile   | (inside the old check all path)                             | catalogue row, textually the SAME command line (`mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` at root, plain) | same command by construction   |
| check critic    | intersection of intent-declared x headless (author/content drop out) | the SAME builtin logic, proven line-identical at Baize      | same dispatch                  |
| check parity    | `mix test <capability fence file>`                          | config row, same file -- the mix scoped pair above IS this file: 43 passed both sides | same fence, same verdict       |

## Byte-identical probes

`version` (bare), `-v`, `version show`, unknown command (rc 2), `cli --version` (through the REAL Rust binary, stale-debug warning and all), the env-contradiction refusal (`test mix --env desktop` -> the same die both sides), and NINE unknown-sub refusals (canon/db/content/desktop/macos/media/contract/build -- content's authored rc-2 quirk included). Twelve byte-identical pairs.

## New-side-only facts, probed

- `version check`: `version: 0.5.0, every sidecar agrees` rc 0 -- the FOUR declared sidecars (three Cargo.toml + the iOS plist) verified live; the first project where sync/check have real work.
- `test all` DIES (`unknown test subcommand`) -- the cmd/test shadow keeps devbin's synthesised aggregate out, as ruled.
- The option-scoping exposure: the Rust CLI's clap surface declares ZERO flags named `--env`/`--fidelity`/`--repl`/`--iex` -- the dispatcher's anywhere-in-argv consumption has no live collision; documented in the cli topic.
- `fmt ldn --check` rc 0 == old `fmt --check` rc 0 (the same `mix control.ldn.fmt --check` underneath).

## Usage-path notes

Bare topics (`test`/`db`/`story`/`canon`/`media`/`macos`/`desktop`/`content`/`contract`/`build`) print topics rc 0 both sides (re-rendered as markdown). Bare `check`: old topic rc 0 -> new usage rc 1, the devbin bare-gate ruling, third project running. `test frotz` dies rc 1 both with the sub list (order of the list differs -- cosmetic).

## Deliberate differences, each with an owner

1. **The promotions override, SURFACED (AC-11.25)**: the old mix and rust runners' authored zero-test tolerance moves to the fleet shape -- both zero shapes promote, `--allow-empty` the per-invocation escape expressing exactly the legitimate-request case the old ruling protected. credo and lua keep their strict no-escape promotions verbatim. Stated in the inventory, the test topic, and here; hv can reverse it.
2. **The toolchain gate gains the Dockerfile arm** (AC-11.26): the image had lagged the pins twice silently; the pre-bump red is sealed. Third image-bearing project to carry the arm -- AC-11.11's count is now 3 of 3.
3. **`check all` composition**: declared rows first (toolchain format clippy parity), catalogue after (compile critic); `deps` + the three domain rows announce as SKIPPED rather than being silently absent. Coverage: the same six CI-parity gates.
4. **Seal suffix family** uppercase; LATEST pointer names unchanged; the legacy `.test.` stray purge is dropped (extinct post-switch; the switch-day clean sweeps existing strays).
5. **`fmt` surface**: bare `fmt` -> usage rc 1; the one real arm is named (`fmt ldn`); elixir/rust/md arms disabled by the project's own reasons.
6. **Surface additions**: `version sync`/`check` (real here), sealed check verdicts under `tmp/check/`, the Devbin group, `test doctor` fencing devbin's machinery.

## What this migration found in devbin (AC-11.11 feed)

- **Issue 0008** (fixed same-day, two levels): the one vendored Markdown file was not prettier-stable, and THIS project's hook rewrote it inside the install commit -- doctor failed the manifest one command later. Template unwrapped at source (`9e760af`), re-vendored fleet-wide (all four doctors green), and `.prettierignore` fences `bin/.devbin/lib/` here. The upgrade path also proved the WP-13 compose-fix live (refused the edit AND kept failing doctor) and surfaced a `--force` counter-reporting oddity, noted in the issue.
- **Issue 0007, second sighting**: `usage: lamplight fmt <elixir|rust|swift|md|all>` advertises four DISABLED arms and omits `ldn`, the one that runs -- config-declared options never reach the gate usage line.

## Not probed at depth, and why

Execution of `server`/`wrighter`/`control` (agent-banned/long-running; dispatch + -h + target validation verified), `repl`/`cli` interactive forms and `test walk`/`nlp` (interactive), `test crank`/`play` (need worlds/briefs), `check corpus`/`coverage`/`integrity` (need a corpus on disk -- the same reason the old `check all` excludes them), `build cli`/`deploy`/`grammar --install` (heavy/prod/human-run; deploy stays HUMAN-RUN, its runner references verified by read), `desktop build`/`clean`, `macos` execution (Apple creds; dispatch + refusals verified), `db proxy`/`seed`, `story` execution, `media`/`models`/`publish`/`canon`/`contract generate` execution (mutating or remote; dispatch + guards verified), `fmt ldn` bare (tree mutation; its --check twin probed green).

## Verdict

Every command the old launcher offered exists under the same name and dispatches; the four sealed gates measured IDENTICAL sets (2802 credo files / 29667 mods-funs, 49/49 lua, the same 20 rust targets with the same counts, 43/43 on the scoped mix file); the one authored permanent red (`check deps`) is red on BOTH sides naming the same facts; the one blindness the old gate had is now a sealed red-then-green strengthening; twelve outputs are byte-identical including the Rust CLI passthrough. Every deliberate difference is enumerated with its owner, and the one overridden authored ruling (the mix/rust zero-test tolerance) is surfaced loudly rather than slipped. This is the evidence step 5 (the switch) is authorised over -- pending hv's explicit per-project go.

## Addendum, 2026-08-09 post-switch: the no-`test all` reading was WRONG, and hv reversed it

The "New-side-only facts" above record `test all` dying as ruled. That reading was cc's inference from the old launcher's shape, and it was wrong: hv runs the full suite routinely, and ruled post-switch that the missing aggregate was an accident of history, not an authored exclusion. `test all` now fans the four sealed gates -- rust, lua, credo, mix, hv's order, the ten-minute ExUnit leg last -- continuing past a breach, with the fleet wrapper flags fanned (`--allow-empty` reaching only mix and rust; credo and lua keep their no-escape promotions) and neither the drivers nor doctor included (Lamplight `402614f3b`). The surviving constraint is behavioural, not mechanical: cc does not run the full mix leg or `test all`; hv does.

Two notes for the record from verifying that change. First, the fan was proven without running a test: dispatch/topic/refusal probes plus a traced four-leg `--purge-only` pass, and hv's own first full-fat `test all` was mid-flight in another terminal as the change landed (rust, lua, credo sealed green; the mix leg running). Second, cc's purge-only probes ran CONCURRENTLY with hv's live run before the concurrency was recognised: they correctly kept hv's in-flight pairs as each family's newest, but consumed the five historical uppercase pairs this pack cites (`1940-11.CREDO`, `1940-43.LUA`, `1942.RUST`, `1943-36.MIX`, `2142.LUA`). The counts and verdicts quoted inline above are the durable record -- which is what the quoting was for, the same precedent as the switch-day clean that consumed the old-side lowercase pairs. The diagnostic lesson is on the board: a file no traced code path creates means ANOTHER WRITER, and `ps` is the first question, not the fourth.
